snippet.description:
How does the YouTube algorithm actually work? Nikhil Kamath puts this question directly to YouTube CEO Neal Mohan.

In response, Neal shares two important pieces of advice for anyone thinking about building a career on YouTube.

First, YouTube's power isn't just about showing people their favourite viral memes or trends. It's about creators themselves — their identity, personality and ability to connect with an audience.

Second, if you're passionate about something, care deeply about it and give it time. Building an audience requires setting realistic expectations.

Neal Mohan also shares an important insight about how the platform works:

"The algorithm is just a reflection of the audience."

A valuable perspective from YouTube's CEO for aspiring creators, YouTubers and anyone trying to understand YouTube growth.
